verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm, but it also ships client-facing legaltech tools (the SCC and Term Sheet generators, a Legora-based AI assistant), so asking for an official MCP server is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec. The Docusign integration and Contract Express automation are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
